name: kettlebell full swing
description: An explosive hip hinge that swings the kettlebell overhead, training the glutes, hamstrings and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, kettlebell on the floor in front.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to swing it overhead.
Let it fall back between your legs while hinging again.
Keep your back flat and repeat in a smooth rhythm.
